chip.description: NES/Famicom CPU (RP2A03G revision): 6502 core without decimal mode plus the on-die APU; taxonomy TB1 files it as cpu.
chip.notes: Deliberate manufacturer/family mismatch: a Ricoh part built around a 6502-family core, filed under the m6502 family as a derivative rather than a straight second source. Deliberately no chip_equivalence edge to m6502 in either direction (coverage.md §1.6): this part lacks the 6502's decimal (BCD) mode, so substitution into a 6502 socket depends on whether the machine's software uses BCD — a fact no table in the schema holds — and a plain 6502 supplies none of this part's on-die APU.
